parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a woman calling about repairing her broken washing machine. First, you have some time to look at questions one to four.

Now, listen carefully and answer questions one to four.

Good morning. This is the customer service department of Kingswell Washing Machine. Roger speaking. How may I help you?

Good morning. I'm calling about the washing machine I bought from the mall several months ago. There's something wrong with it at the moment. So what do I have to do?

Okay. First, I need to get a few details about this. Could you give me your name, please?

Yes, it's Judy Smith.

Okay. I need one more thing. There's a reference number. It should be in the top right-hand corner of the warranty card we gave you.

Let me have a look. Oh, here it is. It's CWX five seven six double eight four.

Thanks. Well, I need to make sure if your washing machine is still within the warranty period. So when did you buy it?

Oh, sure. I remember I bought it last summer, so it was about nine months ago. And the card here says this washing machine has a two-year warranty, so it's definitely within the period.

Of course it is, madam. All right, then, I need your address.

My old address or my current one?

Your current one, as we will send in someone to fix the washing machine for you.

It's a hundred and twenty Middle Street, Oxford.

And the postcode?

It's GO19 4KE.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions five to ten.

Now, listen and answer questions five to ten.

Now, I need to know the exact problem of the washing machine. Could you describe it in detail?

Actually, the washing machine did work very well until last weekend. I put some clothes into it, and it worked normally at first. Then I just got down to doing some gardening. But after about thirty minutes, when I came back to the house, I found it was leaking. The water had soaked the entire floor.

I'm sorry to hear that, madam. So did you do anything to make the leaking stop?

At that moment, the washing machine was totally out of control, and the alarm on it also started to sound. I thought there was not much point in pressing any button on the machine, so I just switched off the machine straight away. Then it stopped leaking at once, thank goodness.

Well, I think that was the only thing you could do.

Oh, then I found my floor was nearly a disaster. As it is made of wood rather than marble, it could not be soaked in water for a long time. So what I did in the next two hours was wiping up the water on the floor.

Right.

Later, I tried the washing machine once more, but the problem still existed.

Well, I've taken down all the related information. Later, we'll send a client engineer to your house to fix it.

Okay. Could you arrange the repair work as soon as possible, as I'm too busy at work to do the laundry by hand? How about this Saturday?

Um, I have to check the schedule of the repairman. Oh, sorry, madam. Saturday has been occupied. The earliest day we can arrange for you is next Tuesday. Is that okay with you?

Fine. I can take a leave from work that day. Anyway, thanks. Oh, my house is easy to find. It's near the central market, just across from the post office.

All right. And the last thing, could you tell me your phone number, please?

Sure. It's three eight six four double seven five seven.

Okay, I've got it. The repairman will contact you before he comes.

Okay, thank you very much.

You're welcome. Bye.

Bye.

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 录音中客服要求提供reference number，女士回答说号码是CWX five seven six double eight four，即CWX576884。

Okay. I need one more thing. There's a reference number. It should be in the top right-hand corner of the warranty card we gave you. Let me have a look. Oh, here it is. It's CWX five seven six double eight four.
你可能会把录音里的“double eight”直接听成单个数字8，要注意英语中连续两个相同数字习惯用double表达。
客服询问购买时间，女士回答是在“last summer”，并补充说明大约是“nine months ago”，填入其中任意一个均可。
你需要注意分辨时间信息，不要被录音随后提到的两年保修期（two-year warranty）干扰而填入错误的数字。

Well, I need to make sure if your washing machine is still within the warranty period. So when did you buy it? Oh, sure. I remember I bought it last summer, so it was about nine months ago. And the card here says this washing machine has a two-year warranty, so it's definitely within the period.
Then I need your address. My old address or my current one? Your current one, as we will send in someone to fix the washing machine for you. It's a hundred and twenty Middle Street, Oxford.
你可能会拼错Middle这个基础词汇，或者只填了Middle漏掉了street导致信息不完整。
客服明确需要current address（当前地址）后，女士报出地址是a hundred and twenty Middle Street, Oxford，卷面上已有120和Oxford，因此填Middle street。
And the postcode? It's GO19 4KE.
英文邮编是字母与数字的组合。
客服紧接着询问postcode（邮政编码），女士直接回答了GO19 4KE。
But after about thirty minutes when I came back to the house, I found it was leaking. The water had soaked the entire floor.
你可能会听到前一句的“leaking（漏水）”就急于填入，但题干“because of the...”后面需要填名词，直接弄湿地板的物质是水。
录音中明确提到“The water had soaked the entire floor（水把整个地板都浸透了）”，对应题目中地板湿了的原因是water。
录音提到洗衣机失控（out of control）后，女士说“I just switched off the machine straight away”，其中straight away同义替换了题干的immediately，对应动作是switched off。

At that moment, the washing machine was totally out of control, and the alarm on it also started to sound. I thought there was not much point in pressing any button on the machine, so I just switched off the machine straight away. Then it stopped leaking at once, thank goodness.
你可能会听到“pressing any button”的干扰，但录音前置了否定描述“not much point in...（没多大意义）”，不要被否定语境中的动作骗了。
Oh, then I found my floor was nearly a disaster. As it is made of wood rather than marble, it could not be soaked in water for a long time.
录音中紧跟着出现了“marble（大理石）”，你可能没听清前面的否定词“rather than（而不是）”就错填了干扰项。
录音中明确说到“As it is made of wood rather than marble”，直接对应题干给出了地板的材质是wood（木头）。
Well, I've taken down all the related information. Later, we'll send a client engineer to your house to fix it.
你可能会漏听前面的修饰词client，只填了engineer，导致答案不够精准。
客服记录完信息后，说“we'll send a client engineer to your house to fix it”，派去修理的人对应题干就是client engineer。

Okay. Could you arrange the repair work as soon as possible, as I'm too busy at work to do the laundry by hand? How about this Saturday? Um, I have to check the schedule of the repairman. Oh, sorry, madam. Saturday has been occupied. The earliest day we can arrange for you is next Tuesday. Is that okay with you?
女士在前文提议了“this Saturday”，客服也复述了Saturday，你如果没听到后面的“has been occupied（已被占满）”，就会落入干扰陷阱。
客服查完排期后表示“The earliest day we can arrange for you is next Tuesday”，对应题目要求的可用时间为next Tuesday。
Oh, my house is easy to find. It's near the central market, just across from the post office.
录音先给出了“central market”，你可能会只抓取到“near”后面的这个地点就直接填入，忽略了介词方位关系的严格对应。
女士描述房屋位置时说“just across from the post office”，其中across from直接同义替换了题干的opposite（在...对面），答案为post office。
